xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5353: Send now: flush a queued message into a running Claude Code turn from the conversation view

plan.title: Send now: flush a queued message into a running Claude Code turn from the conversation view
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: Send now is one user action: a pane-key helper, two server doors, two routes and two UI triggers that are useless apart (a route with no UI, or a UI with no route, ships nothing a user can do). The code surface is three areas (src/lib, src/dashboard, packages/contracts telemetry list); the subsystem metric is inflated because each top-level doc file (configuration/harnesses.mdx, three docs/*.md files, changelog.d/pan-5353.md) and scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt count as their own subsystem.

narratives.Problem: A message sent while Claude Code is busy waits in Claude Code's own queue, and the dashboard bubble reads 'Sent · waiting for transcript' until the turn reaches a tool boundary or ends. In the terminal, Ctrl+Enter on an empty input interrupts the turn and sends the queue now; the dashboard has no way to do that for a message it already sent.
narratives.Proposal: Add Send now: a link on the acknowledged queued bubble, and Ctrl/Cmd+Enter on an empty composer. Both POST a new route (POST /api/conversations/:name/send-now or POST /api/agents/:id/send-now) through the per-conversation send queue. The server door refuses non-Claude-Code, remote, ended/paused/stopped targets, permission prompts and failed ensure-main, then presses Claude Code's send-now chord (tmux one send-keys C-x C-s; Herdr one pane.send_keys ctrl+x ctrl+s) through a new AgentPaneIo.pressSendNow / pressSendNowChord helper, typing no text. The PRD at .pan/drafts/pan-5353.md carries exact files, snippets and decisions D1-D14.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Send now must never type or paste text into the pane; it presses the chord only.
- No Send now for Pi, oh-my-pi, Codex or any harness whose steerKind is not 'send-now-keys'.
- No Send now for remote (Fly) agents.
- No special handling for conversations on another linked machine: they reach the route through the existing generic /api/conversations/@<machine>/... proxy, and an older linked machine's 404 becomes a toast.
- No new pan CLI verb or MCP tool; pan tell --steer stays the shell path.
- No change to Steer (PAN-4292) delivery, the message route, or messageAgent/steerRefusalReason in src/lib/agents/messaging.ts.
- No server-side per-conversation lock; serialization is the frontend send queue for one tab only.
- No reading, clearing or preserving text the operator typed into the pane's own input box.
- No per-bubble flush: the chord flushes every queued message, and the UI says so.
- No new code in src/lib/tmux.ts (at its 1167-line cap) and no allowlist raise anywhere.
- Never send C-Enter / ctrl+enter to a pane.

autoDecisions.summary: Split the server logic into an agent door (src/lib/agents/send-now.ts, owns SendNowResult) and a conversation door (src/lib/overdeck/conversation-send-now.ts).
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the existing import direction: overdeck/conversation-message.ts imports agents/* statically while agents/messaging.ts only lazy-imports overdeck/conversations.js, so one agents-side module importing the conversation store would risk lint:circular.

autoDecisions.summary: The agent door repeats steerRefusalReason's checks with its own codes instead of exporting or refactoring messaging.ts.
autoDecisions.rationale: steerRefusalReason is private and returns a bare string that loses the HTTP code; leaving messaging.ts untouched keeps Steer's behaviour unchanged.

autoDecisions.summary: The agent door checks for a permission prompt with parsePermissionPrompt on one pane read before ensure-main.
autoDecisions.rationale: D4 requires the chord never lands in a permission menu, and ensure-main's Down/Enter keys could answer one; agents have no conversation permission helper, and an unreadable pane still falls to ensure-main's own refusal.

autoDecisions.summary: tmux presses the chord in one send-keys call (C-x C-s), not two sendKeysAsync calls.
autoDecisions.rationale: Same shape as the live probe and the steer path (src/lib/tmux.ts line ~1128), so another writer can never split the chord; tmux.ts is at its cap so the call is made from agent-pane-io.ts via the exported tmuxExecAsync.

autoDecisions.summary: A press that throws answers 502 press-failed; a read-only conversation copy answers 409 with conversationWriteRefusalBody's code; an ended conversation answers 409 not-running.
autoDecisions.rationale: The message route's only liveness gates are conversationWriteRefusal and status === 'ended'; a thrown press is a server-side failure the toast must explain.

autoDecisions.summary: Empty Ctrl+Enter counts as empty only with no pending attachments at all (uploading included) and no citations.
autoDecisions.rationale: An uploading attachment means the operator intends to send it; the existing handleSubmit path then toasts 'Please wait for uploads to finish'.

autoDecisions.summary: Both routes go in one top-level route file, src/dashboard/server/routes/send-now.ts.
autoDecisions.rationale: The no-loss matrix route scanner reads only top-level files in src/dashboard/server/routes/, not routes/agents/.

autoDecisions.summary: The frontend client lives in a new lib/composerSendNow.ts rather than composerSend.ts.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps composerSend.ts free of toast and lets the client item touch no shared file.

items.title: Add AgentPaneIo.pressSendNow and pressSendNowChord

expected_outputs: agent-pane-io-keys.test.ts reports all tests green including the three new pressSendNow cases

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-1 exactly. Add pressSendNow(): Promise<void> to the AgentPaneIo interface (do not widen SelectorKey). In resolveAgentPaneIo's Herdr branch add pressSendNow calling getHerdrApiClient().call('pane.send_keys', { pane_id: pane.paneId, keys: [...STEER_HERDR_KEYS] }) directly (not sendHerdrPaneKeys, whose toHerdrKey mangles C-x). In the tmux branch import tmuxExecAsync, exactPaneTarget and validateSessionName from ../tmux.js and press with one call: validateSessionName(agentId); tmuxExecAsync(['send-keys', '-t', exactPaneTarget(agentId), ...STEER_TMUX_KEYS], { encoding: 'utf-8' }). Export pressSendNowChord(agentId, backend?) that resolves the pane IO and calls pressSendNow. Do not touch src/lib/tmux.ts. Extend agent-pane-io-keys.test.ts with a hoisted tmuxExecAsync spy and three cases: Herdr pane, tmux host, Herdr host with no pane (tmux fallback).

Add the sendNowToAgent door and the SendNowResult type

expected_outputs: send-now.test.ts reports every refusal case and the happy path green

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-2a exactly. Create src/lib/agents/send-now.ts exporting SendNowCode, SendNowResult, AgentSendNowDeps and sendNowToAgent(rawId, deps). Steps in order, each refusal returning before press: normalizeAgentId; getAgentState (import from ./agent-state-read.js, never ../agents.js) null -> 404 not-found; steerKind !== 'send-now-keys' -> 422 steer-unsupported; paused / suspended (getAgentRuntimeStateSync) / stopped -> 409 not-running; remote (lazy import ../remote/remote-agents.js, loadRemoteAgentState(id)?.vmName) -> 422 steer-unsupported; read the pane once with resolveAgentPaneIo(id).read(PANE_CAPTURE_LINES) and refuse 409 permission-pending when parsePermissionPrompt returns non-null (an unreadable pane falls through); ensureMainInputTarget !ok -> 409 input-target-not-main; press via pressSendNowChord, a throw -> 502 press-failed; else { ok: true }. Use the exact error strings in the PRD. Never import src/lib/overdeck/*. Do not modify src/lib/agents/messaging.ts. Tests inject every dep; one case per refusal asserting status, code and that press was not called, plus happy path, permission-before-ensure-main ordering, and unreadable-pane fall-through.

Given press throws, sendNowToAgent returns 502 press-failed whose error contains the thrown message; given readPane throws, ensureMain still runs and press is called

Add the sendNowToConversation door

expected_outputs: conversation-send-now.test.ts reports every refusal case and the happy path green

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-2b exactly. Create src/lib/overdeck/conversation-send-now.ts exporting ConversationSendNowDeps and sendNowToConversation(name, deps), importing the SendNowResult type from ../agents/send-now.js. Steps in order, each refusal returning before press: getConversationByName null -> 404 not-found; conversationWriteRefusalBody(conv) non-null -> 409 with its code and error; conv.status === 'ended' -> 409 not-running; getHarnessBehavior(conv.harness ?? 'claude-code').steerKind !== 'send-now-keys' -> 422 steer-unsupported; when behavior.capabilities.paneInputGuard: conversationPendingPermission(conv)?.answerable -> 409 permission-pending, then ensureMainInputTarget(conv.tmuxSession) !ok -> 409 input-target-not-main; press via pressSendNowChord(conv.tmuxSession), a throw -> 502 press-failed; else { ok: true }. Inject every external call through deps. Tests cover each refusal, the non-answerable permission case (no refusal), and the happy path.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-3 exactly. Create top-level src/dashboard/server/routes/send-now.ts with two HttpRouter.add('POST', '/api/...') routes written with method and path as the first two literals: POST /api/conversations/:name/send-now calling sendNowToConversation and POST /api/agents/:id/send-now calling sendNowToAgent, each running validateOrigin first (403). Map results with an exported pure helper sendNowResponse(result). Export sendNowRouteLayer = Layer.mergeAll(...) and register it in server.ts right after conversationMessageCancelRouteLayer. Add both paths as scope 'tell' rows in route-scopes.ts after the message/cancel row; add two WRITE rows to tests/unit/lib/overdeck/no-loss-matrix.ts after the message/cancel row; add both paths to TELEMETRY_PROPERTY_DOMAINS.client_route in packages/contracts/src/telemetry.ts in plain string order and to the client_route row of docs/TELEMETRY.md in the same order. Run npm run build:contracts before typecheck. Each handler awaits its door with yield* Effect.promise(() => door(param)) (see the PRD snippet). Test the real layer the way color-themes-routes.test.ts does, with both door modules and origin-validation.js mocked: refused origin returns 403 with no door call, success returns 200 { ok: true } with the right name/id, and failures return the door's status and { error, code }; also assert requiredScopeFor for both paths.

Verify Send now live against a busy Claude Code conversation

expected_outputs: the captured pane (or Playwright screenshot) shows the queued QUEUED-X answer and no continuation of the interrupted long reply
metadata.acJustification: Two observable checks (link click and empty Ctrl+Enter) plus the fallback path; files_scope lists only the files a defect found here would be fixed in.

narrative.Action: Implementation checkpoint for PRD AC-9, run after every other code item is done. Build the branch and, in an isolated Playwright browser profile against a dashboard built from this branch (never reload the operator's live dashboard), open a Claude Code conversation writing a long reply, send 'Reply with only the word QUEUED-X', wait for 'Sent · waiting for transcript', click Send now, and confirm the reply stops and QUEUED-X is answered within a few seconds; repeat with Ctrl+Enter on an empty composer; also press Send now once while an AskUserQuestion dialog is on screen and record the result in the PR description (a harmful result becomes a follow-up issue). Fallback when the dashboard cannot be driven: tmux -L sendnowcheck new-session -d -s sendnowcheck 'claude --model haiku', queue one message during a long reply, run a scratchpad Node script with OVERDECK_TMUX_SOCKET_NAME=sendnowcheck calling the built pressSendNowChord('sendnowcheck', { name: 'tmux' }), capture with tmux -L sendnowcheck capture-pane -p -t sendnowcheck, paste the capture into the PR description, then tmux -L sendnowcheck kill-server. Fix any defect found in the listed files before finishing.
